PLAY HAS BEEN ABANDONED! Incessant rains meant we had no further play after just 21 overs. Earlier, Pakistan won the toss and opted to field. They were successful in sending Tom Latham back for a duck when Mohammad Amir struck in his very first over. Kane Williamson was then dismissed by Sohail Khan, thanks to the review taken by Pakistan. The Kiwi skipper was given not out initially but the umpire had to overturn his decision to give the batsman out caught behind. Since then, Jeet Raval and Ross Taylor shared a promising stand which was only brought to a halt due to rain.
OUT c Sarfraz Ahmed b Sohail Khan. New Zealand have lost their second wicket.
OUT c Sami Aslam b Mohammad Amir. New Zealand have lost their first wicket.
The match is about to get underway. NOTE - Due to lack of television feed there won't be commentary available for this match but we will provide you with the final summary of the day's play...

After a delay of 15 minutes due to slight drizzle, both captains come out for the coin toss. Skipper Azhar Ali wins the all-important toss and PAKISTAN WILL FIELD! They have left out Yasir Shah in favour of an extra seamer in Wahab Riaz. Mohammad Rizwan (on Test debut) comes in for Misbah-ul-Haq and Imran Khan is in for Rahat Ali. New Zealand have replaced Trent Boult (unfit) with Matt Henry and Mitchell Santner replaces Todd Astle.
Weather and pitch - The conditions are overcast and it's a lively green pitch. No rocket science - win the toss and field.

Hello and welcome everyone for the second and last Test between New Zealand and Pakistan at the Seddon Park, Hamilton. The hosts registered a comprehensive victory in Christchurch to go 1-0 up in the series and would be eyeing another clinical performance to sweep the series. Pakistan on the other hand are good in making comebacks and would attempt to level the series. They will be without their regular skipper Misbah (banned for one match for slow over-rate) and will be led by Azhar Ali. We are expecting a cracking Test match.
